category: geocoding, autocomplete and reverse geocoding API

free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0: 50,000 requests a month at 2 requests a second, no credit card; monthly periods run from the signup date and unused free credits expire at the end of each period
free_tier.notes: each successful search, retrieve, reverse or resolve-region call costs one credit; autocomplete and region calls cost no credits but count against the rate limit; there is no daily cap and no automatically billed overage; the next plan, Starter, is USD 29 a month for 300,000 requests

per_object_cap.stated: the bulk geocoding page runs a CSV as parallel single search requests at the plan's rate, 7,200 addresses an hour on Free, and names no batch endpoint; dedicated-capacity bulk jobs are an Enterprise item

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in credits, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS JSON API at api.opengeocoding.com/v1/search (a POST with the key in an x-api-key header), a gRPC lane that shares the same credits and rate limit, and a remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in; a keyless call answered HTTP 401 unauthenticated
tooling: any HTTP or gRPC client; a CSV geocoding script on the bulk geocoding page; a remote MCP server
chaining: 50,000 permanently storable searches a month with no card, then USD 29 a month for 300,000; autocomplete and region calls cost no credits; bulk work is a CSV run through the search API at 2 requests a second

limits.value: 50,000 requests a month on the Free plan; free credits expire at the end of each period and there is no automatic overage
2 requests a second on the Free plan, shared across all API keys; HTTP 429 with Retry-After beyond it

binding_note: the bulk geocoding page puts the 50,000 allowance at about 7 hours at the full 2 requests a second, so the monthly allowance is met first

identity_cost.detail: an account at opengeocoding.com with an email address and a password, or GitHub sign-in; free credits are granted after email verification

reliability_note: when credits run out billable operations answer HTTP 429 until a new grant, while autocomplete and regions stay available at zero credits; there is no uptime guarantee outside an enterprise agreement
confidence_note: the pricing page, the home page, the terms, the privacy statement and the bulk geocoding page were quoted on 2026-11-02; a keyless call answered HTTP 401. No account was opened, so the free monthly credits and the sign-up form were not exercised.
